descriptionChirho: The divine act of calling or the state of being called, referring to God's summons to salvation, service, or a particular way of life. All occurrences represent the same noun klesis in various grammatical cases (nominative, genitive, accusative, dative) with no genuine semantic split. Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng 'calling / with calling,' spa 'llamamiento / llamada / con llamamiento,' hin bulaavaa / bulahat / bulahat se, arb da'wah in all clusters, kor bureusim throughout, swa wito consistently. The instrumental dative 'with calling' (S70820) is a syntactic variant, not a separate sense.
